roadmap.title: Recruit the travelers and protect early missables
roadmap.description: This roadmap uses a full-party save and a separate solo speed-run save. Before recruiting a fourth traveler, reveal Meep’s and Cactus Roller’s weaknesses if you want their optional entries. Reveal the required Sea Birdian 4 and Buccaneer I weaknesses in the Coastlands before starting Chapter 2 stories. Get Meryl’s hidden item before finishing her first side story. Then recruit all eight travelers and complete their Chapter 1 stories.

roadmap.title: Finish Chapter 2 and unlock regular jobs
roadmap.description: Complete the Chapter 2 stories and visit the eight regular job shrines. Carry Therion for purple chests. Use Inquire or Scrutinize as you explore towns, then collect the hidden items those actions reveal.

roadmap.title: Finish Chapter 3 and develop the party
roadmap.description: Complete Chapter 3 for each traveler. During Cyrus’s chapter, take the Bone chest before escaping the pit. Collect Bale’s hidden item during Olberic’s Chapter 3 before finishing his Chapter 4. Learn useful support skills and finish the Cobbleston duels.

roadmap.title: Finish all stories and complete exploration
roadmap.description: Before both Cyrus and Alfyn finish Chapter 4, collect Zeph’s hidden item. During Cyrus’s Chapter 4 ending, Scrutinize the two library books before From the Far Reaches of Hell beside Lucia’s body, then check for Original Tome. With those precautions in place, complete all eight Chapter 4 stories. Unlock the advanced jobs and finish the chest, hidden-item, and enemy checklists.

roadmap.title: Complete the side stories and defeat Galdera
roadmap.description: Finish the Kit and Lyblac quest chains to open the Gate of Finis. Prepare both four-person parties for Galdera. Finish the side stories, item collection, maximum-damage hit, and remaining playtime.

roadmap.title: Complete a Tressa solo speed run
roadmap.description: Start a separate Tressa save. Recruit nobody else until her Chapter 4 ending finishes. Use the Fleetfoot route to finish below eight hours and earn both run-specific achievements.

roadmap.title: Finish the achievement list
roadmap.description: Earn every remaining achievement to unlock A Story All Your Own.

achievements.description: Unlocked all achievements.

steps.text: Finish the remaining achievements; this final achievement unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: The ember from the Cave of Origin in hand, Ophilia embarks on the first leg of the Kindling as the Flamebearer.

steps.text: Complete Ophilia's Chapter 1 in @loc{Flamesgrace}.

achievements.description: Rite completed, Ophilia helps three quarreling children mend their friendship before setting out for her next destination.

steps.text: Complete Ophilia's Chapter 2 in @loc{Saintsbridge}.

achievements.description: Ophilia rescues the child kidnapped by the Savior's followers and performs the rite, but she is later betrayed by Lianna. Ophilia must hurry to Wispermill in the Flatlands in pursuit of her sister and the stolen ember.

steps.text: Complete Ophilia's Chapter 3 in @loc{Goldshore}.

achievements.description: The Savior defeated and Lianna saved, Ophilia continues offering guidance to the people of the realm. May the Sacred Flame light your path.

steps.text: Complete Ophilia's Chapter 4 in @loc{Wispermill}.

achievements.displayName: Setting Out – The Search for Truth
achievements.description: Driven from the academy, Cyrus sets out to unravel the mystery of From the Far Reaches of Hell, a tome missing for fifteen years.

steps.text: Complete Cyrus's Chapter 1 in @loc{Atlasdam}.

achievements.description: After Cyrus solves the mystery of the missing townspeople, he and Odette ascertain where a copy of the tome was reproduced.

steps.text: Complete Cyrus's Chapter 2 in @loc{Quarrycrest}.

achievements.description: Yvon defeated, Cyrus chases after the mastermind behind the plot: Lucia, the headmaster's secretary.

steps.text: Complete Cyrus's Chapter 3 in @loc{Stonegard}.

achievements.description: After defeating Lucia in the ancient ruins, Cyrus succeeds in deciphering From the Far Reaches of Hell. He continues his research, resolute in his personal mission to see knowledge passed on to future generations.

steps.text: Complete Cyrus's Chapter 4 in @loc{Duskbarrow}.

achievements.displayName: Setting Out – In Search of Treasure
achievements.description: Tressa dreams of becoming a renowned merchant. With the mysterious notebook she received from Captain Leon in hand, she sets out on her journey to see all the treasures the world holds.

steps.text: Complete Tressa's Chapter 1 in @loc{Rippletide}.

achievements.description: Tressa rescues her rival, Ali, and drives Morlock from the town. Before resuming her journey, Tressa promises Ali they will one day meet again at the Merchants' Fair.

steps.text: Complete Tressa's Chapter 2 in @loc{Quarrycrest}.

achievements.description: After reuniting with Leon and hearing him tell of his friend Baltazar, Tressa wonders just what she treasures most. With those thoughts in mind, she makes for Grandport and the Merchants' Fair.

steps.text: Complete Tressa's Chapter 3 in @loc{Victors Hollow}.

achievements.description: Content in the knowledge that her journey itself was her treasure all along, Tressa entrusts the next chapter of the journal to Noa and presses on, determined to become a famed merchant.

steps.text: Complete Tressa's Chapter 4 in @loc{Grandport}.

achievements.description: The denizens of Cobbleston come out to give their hero Olberic a proper sendoff. The battle with the brigands behind him, Olberic sets out with a renewed sense of purpose.

steps.text: Complete Olberic's Chapter 1 in @loc{Cobbleston}.

achievements.description: Olberic emerges victorious from the tournament and ventures into the desert in pursuit of Erhardt.

steps.text: Complete Olberic's Chapter 2 in @loc{Victors Hollow}.

achievements.description: The brief reunion of the twin blades of Hornburg comes to an end as Olberic takes his leave of the desert town in search of his true adversary: the tyrant Werner.

steps.text: Complete Olberic's Chapter 3 in @loc{Wellspring}.

achievements.description: With Werner defeated, Olberic continues his journey, vowing to protect those in need.

steps.text: Complete Olberic's Chapter 4 in @loc{Riverford}.

achievements.description: Primrose, finally in possession of the lead she needed, takes off in pursuit of the three men bearing the mark of the crow—the men against whom she swore revenge.

steps.text: Complete Primrose's Chapter 1 in @loc{Sunshade}.

achievements.description: Primrose crosses Rufus, the Left-hand Man, off her list and takes the next step in her journey to learn the truth about her father's death.

steps.text: Complete Primrose's Chapter 2 in @loc{Stillsnow}.

achievements.description: With Albus, the Right-hand Man, vanquished, Primrose learns the truth: Simeon, her childhood friend, is responsible for her father's murder.

steps.text: Complete Primrose's Chapter 3 in @loc{Noblecourt}.

achievements.description: Her revenge complete, Primrose sets out anew, vowing to continue dancing.

steps.text: Complete Primrose's Chapter 4 in @loc{Everhold}.

achievements.description: With the encouragement of his dear friend Zeph, Alfyn embarks on a journey to heal Orsterra's sick and wounded.

steps.text: Complete Alfyn's Chapter 1 in @loc{Clearbrook}.

achievements.description: Alfyn exposes Vanessa's plot to sicken the residents of Goldshore so she may treat them at a premium, and saves a young girl who fell ill by Vanessa's hand. His journey now takes him to Saintsbridge, the largest city in the Riverlands.

steps.text: Complete Alfyn's Chapter 2 in @loc{Goldshore}.

achievements.description: Alfyn's faith in his journey is shaken when a man he helped nearly kills a young boy. Ogen's theory that some lives aren't worth saving echoes in Alfyn's head as he makes his way to the Cliftlands.

steps.text: Complete Alfyn's Chapter 3 in @loc{Saintsbridge}.

achievements.description: Alfyn cures Ogen and continues on his journey, carrying on the convictions of Graham, the traveling apothecary who once saved Alfyn's own life.

steps.text: Complete Alfyn's Chapter 4 in @loc{Orewell}.

achievements.description: H'aanit and her trusty snow leopard companion Linde begin their hunt for Master Z'aanta, who has gone missing.

steps.text: Complete H'aanit's Chapter 1 in @loc{S'warkii}.

achievements.description: H'aanit finds Z'aanta turned to stone by the beast known as Redeye. Following the instructions in Z'aanta's letter, she travels to see Susanna the Seeress.

steps.text: Complete H'aanit's Chapter 2 in @loc{Stonegard}.

achievements.description: H'aanit fells a dragon and obtains the herb that should ward off Redeye's curse. Brew in hand, H'aanit makes haste for the desert where Redeye was last seen.

steps.text: Complete H'aanit's Chapter 3 in @loc{Stillsnow}.

achievements.description: H'aanit defeats Redeye and at last reunites with her master. Surely this is the first in a long line of tales yet to be told.

steps.text: Complete H'aanit's Chapter 4 in @loc{Marsalim}.

achievements.description: Therion sets out to obtain the three dragonstones in a bargain that would see the fool's bangle marking him a criminal removed.

steps.text: Complete Therion's Chapter 1 in @loc{Bolderfall}.

achievements.description: Therion vanquishes Orlick to claim the ruby dragonstone before following the trail of the emerald dragonstone to a desert town.

steps.text: Complete Therion's Chapter 2 in @loc{Noblecourt}.

achievements.description: Therion finds the emerald dragonstone at last, only to have it stolen by none other than Darius, his former partner in crime.

steps.text: Complete Therion's Chapter 3 in @loc{Wellspring}.

achievements.description: Therion wrests control of the emerald and gold dragonstones from Darius. His freedom restored, Therion resumes traveling wherever the wind takes him.

steps.text: Complete Therion's Chapter 4 in @loc{Northreach}.

achievements.description: Saw your journey through without aid from others.
achievements.summary: Finish the starting traveler's four chapters without recruiting another traveler.

steps.text: Start a separate game as @npc{Tressa}. Leave every other traveler unrecruited until her Chapter 4 ending finishes.
Prepare Tressa with the solo route under Fleetfoot. Secondary jobs, captured monsters, and summoned townspeople are allowed.
Complete her chapters in @loc{Rippletide}, @loc{Quarrycrest}, @loc{Victors Hollow}, and @loc{Grandport}. Let the ending and credits finish before recruiting anyone.

achievements.description: Finished your journey with lightning speed.
achievements.summary: Finish the starting traveler's Chapter 4 with less than eight hours on the save timer.

steps.text: Start a separate game as @npc{Tressa} and skip cutscenes. Follow the route below without recruiting other travelers to earn Lone Traveler on the same run.
In Chapter 1, learn @mechanic{Hired Help}. Keep the @item{Refreshing Jam} from the Caves of Maiya and save the Jams collected later for Esmeralda.

Get Scholar at the @loc{Shrine of the Sage} in Western Noblecourt Flats. Learn @mechanic{Lightning Bolt} and @mechanic{Lightning Blast}. These two purchases unlock @mechanic{Evasive Maneuvers}; equip that support skill while traveling.

Collect money from high-level areas with Evasive Maneuvers equipped. Useful chests hold @item{50,000 leaves} in the Shrine of the Runeblade, @item{35,000 leaves} in Everhold Tunnels, and @item{30,000 leaves} in Loch of the Lost King. Save before entering dangerous areas.

In Grandport Markets, buy @item{Rune Glaive} from the Merchant near the fish stand. Buy @item{Forbidden Shield} from the Merchant on the west side of the Bazaar entrance. In southwest Stonegard Valleys, buy @item{Elemental Augmentor} from the Elderly Shopowner.

Visit Demure Grandma in Saintsbridge: Upstream to buy @item{Elemental Hat}. East of the Noblecourt inn, the Elderly Woman outside the guarded house sells @item{Sorcerer’s Robe}. Get @item{Forbidden Bow} from Goldshore’s Elderly Woman near the Manor District entrance.

Equip Scholar and train to about @item{level 29} in @loc{Tomb of Kings}, using boosted @mechanic{Lightning Blast}. Equip Forbidden Bow and remove Evasive Maneuvers while farming. Learn Merchant’s @mechanic{Trade Tempest}, Dancer’s @mechanic{Second Wind}, and Scholar’s @mechanic{Vim and Vigor} before moving on.
Complete Chapter 2 in Quarrycrest. Break Omar with ice attacks and hit him with boosted Lightning Blast. Get @mechanic{Arrowstorm} from Hunter and @mechanic{Thousand Spears} from Warrior.

Begin Chapter 3 in Victors Hollow. Train in the Forgotten Grotto to about level 36, then use Hunter in @loc{Maw of the Ice Dragon}. Break enemies with Arrowstorm and damage them with boosted @mechanic{Trade Tempest}.

Train to about level 47. Learn @mechanic{Saving Grace} from Cleric, @mechanic{Heightened Healing} from Apothecary, and @mechanic{Stout Wall} from Warrior. Equip the first two support skills. Buy @item{Dragonscale Armor} from Swordsman Yuri in Marsalim and take the @item{Crystal Helm} from Dragonsong Fane.
Finish Chapter 3 as Warrior. Use Thousand Spears to break Venom Tiger, then boosted Tradewinds for damage. Equip an @item{Antidote Stone} and use Rest for healing so you can keep your Jams.

Before Chapter 4, reserve @item{180,000 leaves} for six Veteran Soldiers summons. Purchase Jams from Tressa’s father in Rippletide, the right-hand Tavern Patron in Sunshade Tavern, and the Merchant at the Grandport Markets entrance. Aim for eight Refreshing Jams and five Revitalizing Jams.

Against @enemy{Esmeralda}, keep Saving Grace and Heightened Healing equipped. Use Jams to heal above maximum HP, maintain Stout Wall, and break her with spear attacks or Thousand Spears. Spend three BP on Hired Help: @mechanic{Veteran Soldiers} while she is broken.
Finish Tressa’s Chapter 4 ending before the save timer reaches @warn{8:00:00}. Keep Evasive Maneuvers equipped between training stops and restore a normal bow before boss fights.

achievements.description: Defeated the dark god Galdera and sealed the Gate of Finis once more.
achievements.summary: Defeat Galdera at the Gate of Finis.

guide.context: The Gate of Finis has no save point. A defeat during the final battles means clearing the eight shadow bosses again.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4 for all eight travelers. Finish the two-part @mechanic{Daughter of the Dark God} chain. Also finish both @mechanic{In Search of Father} quests; Worth the Detour lists the solutions.

On @loc{West S’warkii Trail}, speak to the @npc{Impresario} and defeat the Azure-eyed Tiger for Alphas and the Impresario. Speak to him again to start @mechanic{At Journey’s End} and unlock travel to the Ruins of Hornburg.

Prepare all eight travelers before entering the @loc{Gate of Finis}. Aim for levels in the low-to-mid 60s, with strong equipment and healing items. Give both parties a healer and a strong damage dealer.
Clear the eight shadow bosses. Then split your travelers into two parties: the first fights the @enemy{Omniscient Eye}, and the second fights @enemy{Galdera}.

For the Eye, use @mechanic{Runelord Tressa} to share Light Rune through Transfer Rune. Keep the party healthy with a Cleric who has @mechanic{Saving Grace}. Defeat the summoned Souls to expose the Eye, then attack the Eye before the Souls return.

For Galdera, use a @mechanic{Warmaster} with @mechanic{Surpassing Power}. Restore BP with Pomegranates, weaken the boss parts with @mechanic{Armor Corrosive}, and use fully boosted @mechanic{Winnehild’s Battle Cry}. Defeat the parts before attacking Galdera’s exposed body.

collectibles.name: Kit, the Traveler
collectibles.method: Give a Healing Grape to Kit outside your starting town.

collectibles.name: Sir Miles, Servant of the Flame (I)
collectibles.method: Question Former Knight Ardante in Flamesgrace Cathedral with Inquire or Scrutinize. Report Rumors of a Knight Ardante to Miles.
collectibles.note: Available after Ophilia Chapter 1.

collectibles.name: The Innocent Inmate
collectibles.method: Use Inquire or Scrutinize on the Witness in Flamesgrace. Tell the Accused Man the information called An Eyewitness Account.
collectibles.note: Available after Ophilia Chapter 1.

collectibles.name: The Slumbering Giant
collectibles.method: Question the Muttering Codger in Flamesgrace about Where the Ice Giant Sleeps. Defeat Jötunn in Hoarfrost Grotto and deliver Jötunn Horn to the Diligent Student.
collectibles.note: Available after Ophilia Chapter 1.

collectibles.name: Lianna and Eliza
collectibles.method: Accept Lianna’s quest in Flamesgrace Cathedral. Speak with Lianna or Eliza in Wispermill, then defeat the Remnant Leader in Forest of Purgation using Challenge or Provoke.
collectibles.note: Available after both Ophilia and H'aanit Chapter 4.

collectibles.name: Sir Miles, Servant of the Flame (II)
collectibles.method: Win a Challenge or Provoke battle against Miles.
collectibles.note: Available after Sir Miles, Servant of the Flame (I).

collectibles.name: Let There Be Warmth
collectibles.method: In Stillsnow, buy or steal @item{Adequate Flax} from the Villager at the southwest edge. Get @item{Portable Pot} from the Townsperson behind the snowmen east of the tavern. Get @item{Satisfactory Coal} from the Villager at the northwest edge. Deliver the three items to the @npc{Ingenious Inventor}.

collectibles.name: Setting Out
collectibles.method: Use Challenge or Provoke to defeat the Pathetic Father in Stillsnow’s tavern.

collectibles.name: Arianna Again (I)
collectibles.method: Before advancing this chain, get the Traveler’s hidden item on Trail to the Whitewood. Use Guide or Allure to take Arianna to Natalia in Stonegard.

collectibles.name: Arianna Again (II)
collectibles.method: Use Guide or Allure on Oren in Stillsnow. Bring Oren to Natalia in Stonegard.
collectibles.note: Available after quest Arianna Again (I).

collectibles.name: Sir Miles, Servant of the Flame (III)
collectibles.method: Buy or steal Memorial Sword from Northreach’s Refined Merchant. Hand the sword to Miles.
collectibles.note: Available after Sir Miles, Servant of the Flame (II).

collectibles.name: Ogen's Epilogue
collectibles.method: Visit the Flower Girl in Victors Hollow and obtain Mind-me-always with Purchase or Steal. Take the flowers to Ogen in Northreach.

achievements.description: Traveled to every location on the map.
achievements.summary: Visit every map area on one save file.

steps.text: Complete all eight stories and visit every chest area listed under Treasure Hunter. Enter each separate town district and dungeon floor while exploring.
Enter all 12 job shrines, including the eight regular shrines and four advanced-job dungeons. The Wisdom achievements list their entrances.
Follow the Closure quest chain to the @loc{Ruins of Hornburg}. Enter the @loc{Gate of Finis}; reaching the gate is necessary even if the rest of the map is complete.

achievements.description: Learned every skill.
achievements.summary: Learn every job skill across all 12 jobs on one save file.

steps.text: Unlock the eight regular jobs and four advanced jobs at their shrines.
Finish the 12 job-mastery achievements. Each job needs a traveler who has learned its full skill list, including its Divine Skill.

achievements.description: Learned every support skill.
achievements.summary: Learn every support skill across all 12 jobs on one save file.

steps.text: Unlock all 12 jobs. For each job, have a traveler learn the seven normal job skills to gain its four support skills.
Use @mechanic{4,630 JP} per regular job or @mechanic{10,000 JP} per advanced job to reach the fourth support skill. Divine Skills are unnecessary for support-skill completion.

achievements.description: Acquired every item.
achievements.summary: Acquire every equipment, consumable, and Valuable type on one save file, except Obsidian Garb and Brigand’s Garb.

guide.context: An item still counts after you sell, use, or hand it in. Keep one copy when convenient so you can see which item types you have already acquired.

steps.text: After defeating Lucia in Cyrus’s Chapter 4, Scrutinize the two library books: @item{Trial of the Twelve, Volume VII} and @item{Forbidden Gold}. Leave the book beside Lucia’s body, @item{From the Far Reaches of Hell}, until last. Scrutinize that final book and check Valuables for @item{Original Tome} before proceeding.
Complete all side stories, open all treasure chests, and collect all hidden items. Defeat @enemy{Galdera} to receive @item{Spurning Ribbon}.
Visit every town’s shops and obtain any item type you have never owned. Use Inquire or Scrutinize to unlock expanded shop stock where available.

Use Purchase or Steal on townspeople throughout every region, including NPCs who appear after Chapter 4. Obtain their equipment, consumables, and Valuables even when you solved their side story another way.

For rare NPC drops, Challenge the @npc{Erstwhile Retainer} in Atlasdam for @item{Feather Duster}, the @npc{Roving Naturalist} on North S’warkii Trail for @item{Mace}, and the @npc{Fishmonger} in Clearbrook or West Clearbrook Traverse for @item{Hip Flask}. Leave the area and return to fight again if the item does not drop.

If Collector remains locked after checking equipment and consumables, check Valuables. @item{Giant Tusk} comes from the Nomadic Hunter on North S’warkii Trail, even if you resolved Rite of Passage using information.

achievements.description: Dealt maximum damage.
achievements.summary: Deal 99,999 damage with a single hit.

steps.text: Learn and equip Warrior’s @mechanic{Surpassing Power} on Olberic. For a strong late-game setup, also equip @mechanic{Fortitude}, @mechanic{BP Eater}, and @mechanic{Physical Prowess}. Give him a high-attack sword.
Let Olberic lose a Challenge so he returns with 1 HP. Take Olberic, Therion, Primrose, and Alfyn to the @loc{Subterranean Study} beneath Atlasdam and find an Ice Sentinel or Fire Sentinel.
Defeat the other enemies. Use @mechanic{Armor Corrosive} on the Sentinel and @mechanic{Lion Dance} on Olberic. Restore Olberic’s BP with Pomegranates.
Break the Sentinel, then have Olberic use a fully boosted @mechanic{Brand’s Thunder}. If the hit falls short of @item{99,999}, improve Olberic’s attack equipment before trying again.
